name: Nanami Manami
source:
Nanami Manami is [url=/c504]Nanami Mina’s[/url] younger sister. She attends the Okihara Girl’s School in the mainland. A talented pianist, Manami is a polite and feminine girl, though at some points she’s really similar to her sister. At first she had a terrible fear of men, which made her a very dangerous girl when equipped with her electric baton. To protect Manami’s delicate fingers, Nanami did all of the housework.

[Edited from [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2010/02/15/asunana-nanami-manami/]Rin's character review[/url].]
